$comment: Ghostly's brand, in one place. The /brand page (app/brand), the press kit (scripts/brand-kit.mjs, built into public/brand/ by prebuild and predev) and scripts/brand.test.mjs read this file. The test fails when the site's tokens (app/globals.css, app/site.css), the lockup (components/site/Brand.tsx, apps/ui/src/components/AppBrand.tsx, public/favicon.svg) or the app's themes (apps/ui/src/index.css) say something else, and when a contrast pair misses the level its use needs. Change a colour here and in the CSS together. The wordmark's outline is Inter 4.001 Bold, GHOSTLY, tracking -0.025em, at 100 units to the em, made once with opentype.js (see logo.wordmark.source).
name: Ghostly

foundation.oneLine: Ghostly is a free, open source messenger that connects you straight to the people you invite, with no account and no server holding your messages.
foundation.promise: Your conversations go from your device to theirs. Nobody in between keeps them, reads them or sells them.
foundation.tagline: Find each other. Talk peer to peer.

traits.name: Private by build
traits.text: Privacy comes from how Ghostly works, not from a promise. We say what the network sees, plainly.

traits.name: Friendly
traits.text: A ghost that waves, not one that haunts. Warm, a little playful, never spooky or edgy.

traits.name: Plain-spoken
traits.text: Short words, short labels, the truth about limits. Details wait behind an ⓘ.

traits.name: Open
traits.text: Open source, open protocol (the WISPs), built in public. Anyone can read the code and build a client.

isNot: Not a crypto token or a coin. Ghostly can send sats and other money, but it sells nothing.
Not a social network. There is no feed, no public profile to grow, no follower count.
Not anonymous by default. A direct connection shows your IP address to the contact you talk to.
Not a company's cloud. There is no Ghostly server that holds your account, because there is no account.
Not a horror brand. No skulls, blood, cobwebs or dark-web looks.

boilerplate.short: Ghostly is a free, open source, peer-to-peer messenger: chat, call, and send files and sats straight to the people you invite, with no account and no server holding your data.
boilerplate.long: Ghostly is a free and open source messenger that connects people directly. Two people find each other through a private invitation and a small rendezvous on the public Mainline DHT, then talk device to device over WebRTC, Iroh or HyperDHT, end to end encrypted. There is no account to create, no phone number, and no server that stores messages, contacts or keys. Ghostly runs in the browser, as a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, as a Chrome extension and as a command line tool. It does one-to-one and group chats, voice and video calls, large files, payments in Bitcoin and other money, shared apps and services, and verified identities. Its wire protocol is written down in public specifications, the WISPs, so anyone can build a compatible client. Ghostly is made by Miguel Medeiros and contributors and is released under the MIT License.

colorways.name: Ghost cyan
colorways.use: The default. On Night and every dark surface.

colorways.name: Night
colorways.use: On white, light greys and on Ghost cyan.

colorways.name: White
colorways.use: On dark photos and colours that are not ours, where cyan would clash.

donts.text: Don't recolour it outside the four colourways.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or bevels.
Don't draw it as an outline.
Don't place it on a busy picture without a calm area.

core.name: Night
core.role: The background of every page. The dark the ghost glows on.

core.name: Shade
core.role: Cards, panels and code blocks on Night.

core.name: Ghost cyan
core.role: The logo, links, focus rings and the one main action of a view.

core.name: Signal green
core.role: The app's default accent (Classic theme) and the end of the main button's gradient.

extended.name: Night 2
extended.role: A second background for alternating bands.

extended.name: Shade 2
extended.role: The top of a card's gradient.

extended.name: Dim
extended.role: Notes and the quietest text, on Night and the Shades only.

extended.name: Tile
extended.role: The rounded square behind the icon (favicon, app icons).

extended.name: Cyan deep
extended.role: Cyan on light pages, and pressed states.

extended.name: Casper mint
extended.role: Casper, the second ghost, and Available badges.

extended.name: Shade ghost
extended.role: A third, quiet ghost in a crowd, and Research badges.

extended.name: Amber
extended.role: Highlights in diagrams. Not for warnings in the app.

extended.name: Rose
extended.role: A ghost's cheeks, diagrams and charts.

app.note: The app has four colour themes, each light and dark. Classic is the default. Values come from apps/ui/src/index.css; a theme that leaves a token out takes Classic's.

families.name: Inter
families.role: Every word on the website, the press kit and slides: headings, body, buttons.

families.name: JetBrains Mono
families.role: Eyebrows, captions, chips, keys, commands and code. Never a whole paragraph.

families.name: System UI
families.role: The app itself and the wordmark on screen: the device's own font, so Ghostly feels native on every platform.
families.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

scale.name: Scene
scale.use: A step or scene inside a section.

scale.name: Lead
scale.use: The paragraph under a title, in Haze.

durations.name: Base
durations.use: A small change: a chip, a caption, a card.

durations.name: Slow
durations.use: A large element or a whole scene arriving.

durations.name: Beat
durations.use: One story beat played in full. The longest anything runs unless the reader scrolls it.

easings.name: Enter
easings.use: Arriving: a fast start, a long soft landing.

easings.name: Exit
easings.use: Leaving: a quiet start, gone quickly.

easings.name: Move
easings.use: Travelling on screen from A to B.

easings.name: Burst
easings.use: A ring bursting out once, when two ghosts connect.

easings.name: Hop
